name: Bull vs Medved
summary: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the interplay between bullish and bearish forces, likely using moving average crossovers or momentum indicators to determine market direction. It opens positions in the direction of the prevailing trend and manages them with basic stop-loss and take-profit levels. The strategy aims to capture directional moves while filtering out counter-trend signals.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于多空力量对比的趋势跟踪策略，可能使用均线交叉或动量指标来判断市场方向。它沿 prevailing 趋势方向开仓，并使用基本的止损和止盈水平进行管理。策略旨在捕捉方向性行情，同时过滤逆势信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用趋势跟踪策略，核心概念是基于多头（Bull）与空头（Medved/Bear）力量的对比来判断市场方向。入场条件通常基于移动平均线交叉或类似动量指标的信号，当多头力量占优时做多，空头力量占优时做空。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及可能的趋势反转信号。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损参数来控制单笔风险，但可能缺乏整体账户风险控制机制。该策略在趋势明确的市场中表现较好，但在震荡市中可能产生较多假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy whose core concept is based on the comparison between bullish (Bull) and bearish (Medved) market forces to determine direction. Entry conditions are typically based on moving average crossover signals or similar momentum indicators, going long when bullish forces dominate and short when bearish forces prevail. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels as well as possible trend reversal signals. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or balance-proportional lot calculation methods. In terms of money management, the EA provides stop-loss parameters to control per-trade risk, but may lack comprehensive account-level risk controls. The strategy performs well in clearly trending markets but may generate numerous false signals leading to consecutive losses during choppy, range-bound conditions.

pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，容易理解和优化
有明确的止损止盈设置，单笔风险可控
策略在趋势行情中具有较好的盈利潜力
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic that is easy to understand and optimize
Defined stop-loss and take-profit settings provide per-trade risk control
Good profit potential in trending market conditions
cons: 震荡市中容易产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏整体账户级别的资金管理和风险控制机制
可能缺少滑点和点差的过滤保护，实盘表现可能偏差
cons_en: Prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in range-bound/choppy markets
Lacks comprehensive account-level money management and risk control mechanisms
May lack spread and slippage filters, causing real trading performance to deviate from backtesting
improvements: 增加趋势强度过滤器（如ADX）以减少震荡市中的假信号
加入账户级别的资金管理，如最大回撤限制和每日亏损限制
增加点差过滤和新K线检查以提高实盘稳定性
improvements_en: Add a trend strength filter (e.g., ADX) to reduce false signals in choppy markets
Implement account-level money management such as maximum drawdown limits and daily loss limits
Add spread filtering and new bar checks to improve real-trading stability

risk_points: 震荡行情中可能产生连续亏损，缺乏整体风险控制
没有点差过滤机制，高波动时段滑点可能较大
仓位管理可能不够灵活，固定手数在高杠杆下风险较大
risk_points_en: Consecutive losses possible in range-bound markets without overall risk controls
No spread filter mechanism, slippage may be significant during high-volatility sessions
Position sizing may lack flexibility, fixed lots pose higher risk with high leverage

The strategy aims to capture directional moves while filtering out counter-trend signals.
